title: On the existence of nonconstant solutions of system of Lane-Emden equations on $\mathrm{RCD}^*(-K,N)$ spaces
summary: In this article, we establish elliptic gradient estimates for positive solutions of the Lane-Emden system on metric measure spaces satisfying the synthetic Ricci curvature-dimension condition $\mathrm{RCD}^*(-K,N)$. Our approach combines the weak differential calculus and the Bochner inequality available in the $\mathrm{RCD}^*(-K,N)$ setting with suitable auxiliary function arguments, extending classical gradient estimate techniques to nonsmooth spaces.
